data.rule: With many lanes committing event logs to main, `ddflow gate run <id> unit_tests` on a loaded machine (load 50+) takes about 38 minutes and its outcome is dropped as superseded when the tree moves, losing the failing test names too. Before a phase-closing full run: check load, pass a pinned ref if the gate takes one, and keep the failure list out of band; never expect two sequential attempts to land.
